period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported) as at 2023-09-30. Table title itself does not say 'Consolidated' or 'Solo' ('Evaluation of the Quarterly Financials by the Audit Committee and by the Board'), but its own Dec-31-2023 column reproduces total_assets (369,327.17), gross_loans (261,023.40), total_deposits (262,583.64), total_liabilities (345,221.51) and total_equity (24,105.52) matching the already-confirmed-CONSOLIDATED 2023_Q4.json to within normal rounding, confirming this table is Consolidated basis too -- same basis as the rest of MTB's series, no mismatch. DISCREPANCY FOUND vs the already-stored 2023_Q4.json (sourced from mtb-annual-report-2023.txt (own report, SGR-cross-checked)): tax_expense (table 709.46 vs stored 709, -0.06%). This session's source is mtb-annual-report-2023.txt's OWN contemporaneous 'Evaluation of the Quarterly Financials' table for FY2023 -- i.e. more contemporaneous than the currently-stored Q4 figure for the fields listed. Per this task's explicit scope limits, 2023_Q4.json is left UNMODIFIED; this divergence is recorded here and in sources.json for a future session to reconcile (see project standing rule preferring contemporaneous over later-restated figures -- the fields above are exactly the kind of case that rule is meant to catch). Other fields (total_assets, total_liabilities, total_equity, profit_after_tax) match closely (<0.08% drift, ordinary rounding). BONUS CROSS-VALIDATION: this table's Dec-31-2023 Total Liabilities (345,221.51) independently reproduces the figure 2023_Q4.json already sourced from a *different* table in the same report (the Sustainable Growth Rate calculation, 345,221) rather than that report's own 'Five Years at a Glance' table (343,218) -- a third independent confirmation that 345,221 is the correct FY2023 total-liabilities figure. Balance-sheet identity (Total Property and Assets = Total Liabilities + Total Capital & Shareholders' Equity + Non-Controlling Interest) validated exactly (max drift BDT 0.01m, pure decimal-rounding noise) for all four quarters of 2023, including this Q3. Non-Controlling Interest (~BDT 0.13-0.14m) is omitted as its own line item here (rounds to 0 in whole millions) but is included in the identity check above. Cumulative Total Operating Income, Net Profit After Tax and Interest Income all increase monotonically Q1->Q2->Q3 for 2023 (Q1=4,049.62, Q2=8,325.63, Q3=12,842.50 for operating income; Q1=671.65, Q2=1,078.73, Q3=1,907.53 for net profit after tax) -- no violation.
